title: 背上げ状態の病室ベッド
description: 診療施設の病室背景に置く背上げ状態のベッド。分割マットレスと上体側の傾斜面、ヘッド・フット板、左右の短い側柵、固定された昇降リンクと駆動部外形、四つの車輪・ブレーキ外形、無表示の側面操作部を造形。搬送ストレッチャーとは異なる病室用設備として一式1点です。患者・寝具の装飾は含まず、昇降・電動・荷重・医療安全性能は実装・検証していません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.122 × 1.210 × 2.191 m、18,368三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A bed with raised back section for clinic and hospital room backgrounds. It has divided plain mattresses, inclined upper-body support, head/foot boards, short side rails, fixed lift links/actuator exterior, four casters with brake exteriors and an unlabelled side control block. It is a ward-room assembly rather than a transfer stretcher and counts as one model. Patient and decorative bedding are absent; adjustment, electrical, load and medical-safety performance are not implemented or validated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.122 × 1.210 × 2.191 m; 18,368 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
